description: This line plot illustrates the training loss evolution over iterations for five different model configurations, with the y-axis representing 'Loss' on a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, and the x-axis representing '#Iteration' on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000. The legend identifies five distinct lines: 'Vanilla' (purple, dashed line), 'StrmLLM (n=64)' (blue, solid line), 'SepLLM (n=64)' (orange, solid line), 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' (green, solid line), and 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' (red, solid line), as well as 'SepLLM (n=128)' (dark blue, solid line). All lines begin at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a rapid initial decline, followed by a slower, more gradual decrease as iterations increase. The 'Vanilla' model starts at approximately 3.4 and drops to around 2.6 by iteration 140,000. The 'StrmLLM (n=64)' model begins at approximately 3.4 and settles at around 2.68 by iteration 140,000. The 'SepLLM (n=64)' model starts near 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.58. The 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' model begins near 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.57. The 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' model starts near 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.57. The 'SepLLM (n=128)' model begins near 3.4 and ends at approximately 2.62.
